title: FEWER BIG ROBOTS AT THE EXTRACTION
why: His son, 2026-10-03: too many big robots at the final extract. The siege that answers a called extraction sent up to 6 + 8 x greed machines, half of them sentries. It sends up to 5 + 7 x greed now, and about three in ten are sentries; the rest are crawlers. The rate is unchanged.
now: The extraction siege sends fewer machines and far fewer of the big ones.

edits.replacement: var siegeIv=(8-4.6*GR)/_sv85, siegeCap=Math.round((5+7*GR)*_sv85);   // v16.xx: his son, fewer at the ring (was 6+8*GR)
var nm=rr()<.3?mkSentry(ss2.x,ss2.y):mkCrawler(ss2.x,ss2.y);   // v16.xx: his son, fewer big robots: three in ten are sentries (was one in two)
